Tell me how you plan a weekend trip.
[T001] Stakeholder: I usually compare three hotels before booking, and I want the total price with breakfast visible.
[T002] Interviewer: Anything you want to avoid?
[T003] Stakeholder: Yes - I never want a booking confirmed without me seeing the cancellation deadline first.
